csv_project_name: Engineering for Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Kitsap Transit is issuing this Request for Qualifications ("RFQ") to solicit proposals from interested, qualified, and experienced firms to provide Preliminary Engineering (including NEPA and permitting support) and design services necessary to advance the phased rehabilitation of the Port Orchard Intermodal Terminal. The selected Consultant team shall support project definition, design criteria development, marine operations needs assessment, focused alternatives analysis, phasing and packaging recommendations, preliminary engineering, environmental and permitting support, design development, cost estimating, and preparation of final bid-ready PS&E documentation, as authorized by Kitsap Transit.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design
